source: PDF page11 Fig26, vector paths exported via pdftocairo; first of each same-color trace taken as schematic, second postlayout per legend. Curves almost coincident. No graph targets extracted for other papers.
uncertainty: Approximate graph values, not author numerical data. Conservative ±2mV per Vout reading, ±0.04mV/C endpoint sensitivity, ±4mV output span. Curvature/linearity derived from graph is particularly uncertainty-sensitive; no exact claim. Last curve sample ~99.9C extrapolated over final0.1C.

metric_definitions.Linearity_error_percent_FS: 100*max(abs(V-(a*T+b)))/(max(V)-min(V)); least-squares a,b on uniform1C grid. Definition chosen for reproducible graph/simulation comparison; paper does not define scalar linearity.
metric_definitions.Endpoint_linearity_percent_FS: 100*max(abs(V-[V(0)+(V(100)-V(0))*T/100]))/(max(V)-min(V)); endpoint-line definition chosen for repeatable scalar extraction, not supplied in paper.
